stem: Formative diagnostic check 12: A suspected contagious disease would trigger containment and major crop decisions if confirmed. What follows from the high consequence of being wrong?
choices: Use less evidence because action is urgent.
Treat every similar symptom as the same disease.
Wait for widespread damage before documenting the concern.
Use stronger confirmation and appropriate containment/escalation rather than relying on visual similarity alone.
rationale: Higher-consequence diagnoses warrant stronger confirmation and timely escalation/containment.
